newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan dollar ends lower, downtrend seen.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan dollar ends lower, downtrend seen.

text.p: The Taiwan dollar closed slightly lower on Monday, reflecting the U.S. dollar's firmness against the Japanese yen overseas, and dealers said the local unit could trend lower in the near term.
The Taiwan dollar had strengthened since late August over tight Taiwan dollar liquidity and foreign equity fund inflows.
"It seems the uptrend has come to an end because Taiwan dollar liquidity is easing," said one dealer. Another said: "Some players soon may want to short-cover U.S. dollars."
The rate closed at T$27.505 against Saturday's T$27.472. Turnover was US$196.5 million. -- Joyce Liu (2-5080815)
